method: the ACTUAL model-visible contract was captured from the production path (FunctionModel AgentInfo.output_tools during a real-CLI cycle), then compared field-by-field against the production SupervisorPlanDecisionV2 schema, the rendered plan projection, and _planning_instructions_v2; all constructibility/invalidity claims verified deterministically offline
verdict_basis: no prompt-required field is schema-forbidden (schema identity: structural match after pydantic-ai strips non-semantic title/description annotations; every property/const/required/additionalProperties survives)

the action discriminants named by the instructions (delegate_investigation / request_finalization / no_action) exactly equal the three Literal const values; phase_capabilities in the projection match the union literals as a set

availability: the projection exposes eligibility per attention item and status per question, plus source_scopes; no action variant is offered that the deterministic gate would not adjudicate (PLAN has no availability_projection unlike INTEGRATE — see documented_weaknesses)

no operand field is shared across variants with conflicting meaning; attention_handle/question_handle/source_scope_id exist only on the delegate branch, reason_code only on request_finalization/no_action
a legal NoPlanActionV2 is constructible from the instruction-visible surface alone ({action_type:'no_action', reason_code:...}); the empty plan (actions:[]) is also schema-legal

the t2-no-evidence legal no-evidence path is explicitly expressible and was executed END-TO-END through the real CLI with an honest empty specialist result (delegate_investigation -> search_evidence round-trip -> empty proposal -> integration committed, zero fabricated evidence; CF-1 valid-scenario evidence)

schema_field_inventory.additionalProperties: false on every branch (the INVALID_UNION guard)

historical_failure_attribution.rca2a2b_observed: SUPERVISOR_PLAN INVALID_UNION: one action payload matching NO union variant; 8-error presentation (extra_forbidden x7 + missing reason_code x1 across all three branches); one in-band retry then exhaustion
historical_failure_attribution.reproduction: the same payload with the discriminant field named 'type' instead of 'action_type' and otherwise-correct handles reproduces the production 8-error presentation BYTE-IDENTICALLY through the pydantic-ai output-tool path (raw pydantic model_validate yields the 11-pair superset; production diagnostics record the tool path)
historical_failure_attribution.cause_classification: MODEL-SIDE field-naming failure. The discriminant field action_type IS present in every branch of the model-visible schema (const + default); no instruction requests a field named 'type'; the instructions and schema are mutually consistent. This is a model capability failure on the output contract, NOT a prompt/schema mismatch.
historical_failure_attribution.explicitly_not_claimed: this audit does NOT claim the Strict+CompactTyped unified envelope (RCA-2A.1) would have prevented this specific failure; it is recorded as hypothesis only, per the 2A.2b report

weakness_1_non_discriminated_union.observation: PlanActionV2 is a plain Union (no Field(discriminator='action_type')), so the rendered schema is anyOf without a discriminator mapping, and a payload matching no branch produces cascading errors from ALL branches (8-error presentation) instead of one targeted discriminant error
weakness_1_non_discriminated_union.impact: weaker models get a noisier, less actionable retry prompt; retry feedback was verified working but produced no self-correction (2A.2b: 4/4 exhausted; 2A.2c reproduction: same)
weakness_1_non_discriminated_union.disposition: recorded as hardening opportunity only; any schema change is a production model-face change and is NOT authorized in RCA-2A.2c

weakness_2_v2_instruction_regression_on_.observation: the v1 planning instructions stated 'delegate_investigation actions must reference an eligible attention item, an active question and an allowed source scope'; the v2 instructions retain only the handle-reference rule and the source_scope allow-list rule — the eligibility/active-question constraint is enforced deterministically (PLAN_ATTENTION_ITEM_INELIGIBLE / PLAN_QUESTION_INACTIVE) and the data is visible (eligibility/status fields) but the RULE is no longer stated in the model-visible contract
weakness_2_v2_instruction_regression_on_.impact: none on the tested domain (t2-no-evidence: one eligible item, one open question); a model could lawfully pick an ineligible item and get deterministically rejected
weakness_2_v2_instruction_regression_on_.disposition: recorded as instruction-regression candidate for a future authorized prompt revision; NOT changed here

weakness_3_no_plan_side_availability_pro.observation: INTEGRATE carries availability_projection (offered action variants by handle-kind counts); PLAN carries only phase_capabilities (all three actions always) — with zero eligible items the delegate variant remains schema-legal though deterministically doomed
weakness_3_no_plan_side_availability_pro.disposition: recorded; same authorization boundary as above

documented_weaknesses.leniency_note: because every branch's action_type carries a default, the JSON-schema field is not required; a payload omitting the discriminant entirely resolves to DelegateInvestigationActionV2 (smart-union best match). Leniency is fail-open at the schema layer only — handle resolution and the deterministic validator remain fail-closed.
